column1: # planning/parity/fixture-status.tsv — the HTTP status of every recorded fixture.
# Deferred child D-a. The 24 bodies in app/Sources/MCPRouterKit/Control/Fixtures carry no status,
# so a port could answer every one of them byte-for-byte under the wrong status code and the whole
# decode suite would still pass. This is the missing half of that contract.
# Captured by scripts/acceptance/parity-fixture.sh, which re-runs F3's own recorder with STATUS_DIR
# set against a live reference. The fixture files themselves are never written to — they are the
# wire contract, and a lane that edits its own oracle proves nothing.
